title: Self-assigned IP address
content: Confirm the device has a 169.254 address. Renew the DHCP lease, verify the switch port and VLAN assignment, test a known-good cable, and escalate to network operations if neighboring devices are also affected.

title: Intermittent wireless connectivity
content: Compare impact across devices and nearby rooms. Check signal strength, access-point health, authentication logs, and recent configuration changes. Capture packet loss before escalating.

title: Projector no signal
content: Verify projector power, selected input, cable seating, and source output mode. Test a known-good cable and source. Reboot the switcher only after documenting the active class state.

title: Room audio failure
content: Confirm the correct playback device, application volume, mute state, DSP status, and amplifier power. Test local program audio before replacing hardware.

title: Password and cached credential mismatch
content: Confirm the account is active, test web sign-in, remove cached credentials, synchronize the workstation, and retry. Do not ask the user to disclose a password.

title: MFA delivery failure
content: Verify the registered factor and device connectivity. Offer an approved backup factor or recovery workflow and escalate identity changes through the authorized service desk.

title: Application crash after update
content: Record the version and error, test with a clean profile, check compatibility, clear application cache, and roll back only through the approved software-management process.

title: Screen-sharing permission failure
content: Check operating-system privacy permissions, application permissions, meeting role, and display-capture settings. Restart the application after permissions change.

title: Device will not power on
content: Confirm the outlet, power strip, adapter, and cable with known-good components. Disconnect peripherals, hold power for 15 seconds, retry, and tag the device for repair if there is still no response.

title: Touch controller unresponsive
content: Check network and power indicators, clean and restart the panel, verify the controller service, and use the documented manual fallback while the class is active.
